description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice Wispweaver Angel and create four Treasure, four Clue, and four Food tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four artifacts, returning Wispweaver Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, blinking Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.
